title: COMED：多LLM推理中路由与协作之间的缺失环节
summary: COMED提出一种锚点后控制器，通过锚点自一致性、路由边际和轻量对等探测，选择性地进行跨模型协作，仅在协作可能有益时升级。在医疗、科学和通用推理基准上，16个开放权重设置均有提升，MedQA最高提升10.7个百分点，且比密集协作调用更少模型和token。
summary_en: COMED introduces a post-anchor controller for selective cross-model collaboration using anchor self-consistency, router margin, and a lightweight peer probe. It accepts confident answers, verifies ambiguous cases, and escalates only when collaboration is likely beneficial. Across medical, scientific, and general reasoning benchmarks, COMED improves all 16 open-weight settings, with gains up to +10.7 points on MedQA while invoking fewer models and tokens than dense collaboration.
